notes.title: Winter Sale!
notes.content:
[i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i] is once again participating in Steam's Winter Sale! The game is available at a steep discount during this event.

We'd also like to take this opportunity to announce that starting in 2025, we won't be posting one of these announcements for every sale. Sales will still happen, though, so if you haven't got the game yet, please be sure to Wishlist it to stay in the loop!

notes.title: Autumn Sale 2024!
notes.content: Once again, [i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i] is participating in Steam's Autumn Sale! You can grab the game at a great price during this event.

notes.title: Anniversary Sale 2024!
notes.content: [i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i] has been available on Steam for five years as of this week, and we're celebrating with our deepest discount yet! To everyone who's supported this game, thank you, and to newcomers, we hope you have fun!

notes.title: Anniversary Sale 2021!
notes.content: As of this week, it's been two very strange years since [i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i] arrived on Steam. In recognition of that milestone, the game's on sale all week long. Hopefully, we've all got brighter years ahead of us!

notes.title: Summer Sale 2021!

notes.title: May Weeklong Sale!
notes.content: We honestly weren't sure what to call this sale, so we settled on "May Weeklong Sale", because [i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i] is available at a discount all week long, and it's May. Enjoy!

notes.title: Lunar New Year Sale 2021!
notes.content: The first new sale on [i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i] for what will hopefully be a much better year than the last one is here! The game's available at an unprecedented discount for Steam's Lunar New Year Sale.

notes.title: Winter Sale 2020!
notes.content: We're wrapping up 2020 with a Winter Sale discount on [i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i]! Have a happy and safe holiday season, everyone.

notes.title: Autumn Sale 2020!
notes.content: Temperatures are dropping (in some parts of the world), and so is the price of [i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i] (for the duration of Steam's Autumn Sale)!

notes.title: Hallowe'en Sale 2020!
notes.content: [i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i] is participating in Steam's annual Hallowe'en Sale once again! Treat yourself to the game at a discounted price for a limited time.

notes.title: 1st Anniversary Sale!
notes.content: One year ago this week, [i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i] launched on Steam! To celebrate, the game's on sale all week long. To everyone who's supported, bought, wishlisted, reviewed or even looked at this game in the past year, thank you! There's more in the works at Rootton Endeavours, so stay safe and stay tuned!

notes.content: Staying at home and playing games is still a good idea for a lot of people around the world, so [i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i] is once again available at its steepest discount to date this week! Keep staying safe, everyone!

notes.title: Chill at Home!
notes.content: [i]Penguins vs. Bugs[/i] on Steam is available at its lowest price to date this week, because staying home is a good idea for so many people around the world right now, and we want to encourage that good idea. Stay safe, everyone!
